summary: This bill expands federal student loan forgiveness and cancellation programs to include teachers of English learners and bilingual or dual language immersion students.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands eligibility for teacher loan forgiveness and cancellation to include teachers of English learners and bilingual/dual language immersion students. This incentivizes teaching in public schools by reducing financial burdens for certain educators, which can be seen as a form of increased support for public education, though not direct spending.
